title: Euler-totient count of relative-trace APN CCZ classes
summary: Prove that cases (i) and (iii) of the relative-trace construction yield exactly $\varphi(m)$ pairwise CCZ-inequivalent APN classes.

formal_statement.body: For every admissible odd $m$, let $\mathcal F_m$ be the union of the source-admissible APN functions in cases (i) and (iii) of Theorem 2 over $\mathbb F_{2^{2m}}$. Prove that the quotient of $\mathcal F_m$ by CCZ equivalence has cardinality exactly $\varphi(m)$, or determine a counterexample and the resulting class count.

scope.domain: CCZ-equivalence classes of the source's relative-trace quadratic APN functions
assumptions: $f_{i,s,a,b,c}(x)=a\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(bx^{2^i+1})+a^q\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(cx^{2^s+1})$ is an APN instance in the indicated case of source Theorem 2
scope.unresolved_remainder: The exact $\varphi(m)$ class count for every admissible odd $m$ remains unproved; the later case-(i), $i=1$ coefficient-equivalence result does not establish the required full within- and cross-case classification.

citations.label: Zheng--Kan--Li--Peng--Tang, relative-trace APN conjectures
citations.locator: Introduction, Remark 2, and conclusion, journal pp. 7529, 7535--7536

progress.summary: The introduction, Remark 2, and conclusion conjecture that cases (i) and (iii) yield $\varphi(m)$ CCZ-inequivalent APN classes.
